thesis: The worst position in the book at -7.8%, and the stop at 90.92 is now only 6% below spot. SOL has fallen from $105 when the SEC recognised it for commodity trusts on 5 September to $96.88 today - it has given back everything its best catalyst bought and then some. Two macro events land inside 24 hours.
bull_case:
Pattern analyst: setup is a **downtrend within a longer uptrend** - close 96.88, 34.1% below the 252-day high, RSI 45, 63d momentum +24.4%, no breakout, and price now below the 103.35 level the 7 September memo named as the line to hold. Squeeze 0.98, neutral; ATR 4.5% is wide. Verdict: pattern is against entry.

The fundamentals are unchanged and genuinely good: SEC recognition alongside bitcoin and ether for commodity-based trusts, Bitwise's staking ETF past $1B cumulative inflows, Solana leading all chains with $229M of 30-day real-world-asset net inflows, and the Alpenglow upgrade targeting ~150ms finality. Today's news tone is +0.50 and 34% below the 52-week high leaves room if sentiment turns.
bear_case: A token that cannot hold its gains through its own best regulatory news is telling you who is selling. SOL is below both the 103.35 breakout level and its pre-catalyst price, down 7.8% for us, and it sits in the speculative cohort that has been sold hardest all week. The stop is 6% away with ATR at 4.5%, so a single bad session can resolve this. Macro, once for the day: the FOMC decides tomorrow, 16 September. The CLARITY Act faced a **cloture** vote today at 2:15pm ET - a 60-vote threshold merely to begin debate, which even if cleared does not pass the bill - and crypto fell 4-8% across the board today. Brent reached about $107.5, a four-month high, after attacks left Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline offline with repairs possibly taking weeks, while Riyadh seeks to push more volume through Hormuz; Iran says it will not negotiate with Washington until its conditions are met. Own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md): crypto sleeve -6.4%, Sharpe -0.15, 17% win rate over 75 trades. Desk record (research/outcomes.json): 12 closed trades, 0 wins, -$168.00 realised, expectancy -2.76% per trade. Long memos now read 6 good of 7 judged (0.86) - but that figure was 3 of 7 (0.43) yesterday, so a metric that halves and doubles overnight on seven judged memos is noise, not a licence to get bolder. Skip decisions are 20 of 20.
risks: Below both the 103.35 level and its pre-catalyst price
Speculative cohort sold hardest all week
Own backtest: 17% win rate in the crypto sleeve
invalidation: The pattern analyst's level is **90.92**, the trailing stop carried in the packet, about 6% below spot. A close below it ends this. It flips long on a daily close above 110 that reclaims the broken breakout with ETF flows positive.
